# VoiceServerReverb

*Server*

Adds reverberation to one client voice profile after pitch, equalization, distortion and gain. Server player.getVoiceReverb() controls the microphone before encoding; getVoiceReverbFor(listener) controls that speaker's playback only on the listener's client. On a client player, getVoiceReverb() controls the local microphone and getVoiceReverb(speakerUUID) controls local playback. Microphone and playback effects compose; handles for the same profile share settings. Delay history continues between frames in each stream and is cleared at stream end. No extra frames are generated for a reverberation tail.

## Methods

### getPresets {#getpresets}

::: member

Lists the available preset names.

**Returns** `String[]` — a new array containing normal, room, hall, cave and church

:::

### setPreset {#setpreset}

::: member

Replaces the reverberation settings and clears the previous tail. Room has short, damped reflections; hall is more spacious; cave has bright, long reflections; church has a large, diffuse tail. Normal disables the effect. Presets do not change pitch or equalizer settings.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | the preset name, ignoring case, not null |

:::

### reset {#reset}

::: member

Disables reverberation and clears its tail without changing pitch or equalization. Increasing the mix after reset uses the room settings again.

:::

### isEnabled {#isenabled}

::: member

Checks whether reverberation is active.

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — true if the mix is greater than zero

:::

### getMix {#getmix}

::: member

Gets the proportion of reverberated audio in the output.

**Returns** [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) — the mix, from 0.0 to 1.0

:::

### setMix {#setmix}

::: member

Changes the effect strength while retaining the current preset. Zero disables the effect and clears its tail; one outputs only reverberation. Samples are clipped to the 16 bit PCM range if the mixed signal is too loud.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mix` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | the finite proportion of reverberated audio, from 0.0 to 1.0 |

:::
